title: Technology Sector Update for 12/24/2018: BNSO, CTK, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG - Nasdaq.com
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: -0.84%
AAPL: -1.09%
IBM: -0.58%
CSCO: -0.36%
GOOG: -0.67%
Technology stocks were trading lower pre-bell Monday.
In other sector news:
(=) Bonso Electronics International ( BNSO ) was flat as it warned of a potential loss of revenue for the fiscal years ending March 31, 2019 and March 31, 2020, after a tenant in its factory in Shenzhen, China said it plans to terminate its lease agreement.
(-) CooTek ( CTK ) was slightly lower. Monday the company said it launched a daily health report feature for its feminine care app, Cherry.
